_comment: Reference photographs used to set the night colours and proportions of the
3D landmarks. The files themselves are not committed — their licences are
not stated by the repositories that host them — so only these URLs and the
numbers derived from them in refs/analysis.json live here.
fetch_refs.sh re-downloads them into a scratch directory.

mbs_night.shows: Marina Bay Sands and the ArtScience Museum from across the bay, after dark

mbs_wide.shows: the same view, smaller, with more of the podium roof visible

supertrees_night.shows: Supertree Grove lit at blue hour, with the OCBC Skyway

flyer_day.shows: the Singapore Flyer from Marina Barrage: rim, spokes, capsules, A-frame

merlion_night.shows: the Merlion lit at night from the promenade, with the jet, the mane plates and the scaled body all legible

merlion_close.shows: the Merlion from the water, close: the layered mane, the open mouth, the pectoral fin

supertrees_dusk.shows: Supertree Grove at dusk: flared trunks, flat lattice canopies, the Skyway between two of them

skyline_night.shows: the Marina Bay skyline after dark — the city's own colour, away from any one building

jb_causeway_dusk.shows: Johor Bahru from the Singapore side at dusk: the Causeway with its lit pipeline duct, the CIQ where it lands, and the city's mid-rise skyline behind
